tries.speaker: Miss Louisa Marchmont
tries.line: Mrs Pike believes I am to be courted. I am not. My uncle means to sell the house or leave it shut, and I have a fortnight to give him a reason to do neither. So tell me the truth, since you seem to be the only person here who says things once. What does this parish actually want?
